[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...

notes.title: If You Game Is Crashing, This Is How To Fix It
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/288080/BoneTown_The_Second_Coming_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/d174ac7f3ac6c3c1a92f48e585e36b0f788e4fa0.jpg[/img]

We are seeing a lot of people having issues with the game crashing when they enter a new location or try to access some of the new content.

There is a very easy solution to this. The crashes are happening due to Mods you have subscribed to through Steam Workshop.

To fix this issue. 

1. Unsubscribe from all of your Mods. You can right click on the BoneTown icon where you usually start the game and go to the Properties option. In this window, go to the Workshop tab. Here you can see all of the MODs you are subscribed to. Unsubscribe from all of them.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/749d94243eaf72db11ace6f61d23764c7b2012dd.jpg[/img]

2. If it doesn't work, you make need to go to the File Explorer and go to the follow path:
C:\ProgramFiles(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BoneTown\

3. Delete the "workshop" folder

4. Go to the "\game" folder and delete the "MODS" folder

5. Don't open the game yet, uninstall the game and download it again without anything from the workshop.

We have updated all of the MODs we created, but we have no control over when the creators of the other MODs will update their content to work with the new Kinks DLC stuff.

We apologize for this inconvenience. We really want to support the Workshop community, but it bring lots of other issues with it.

We hope this helps anyone who is having issue playing the Kinks DLC.

notes.title: New Save Option and Final Mission Balance Changes
notes.content:
BALANCE CHANGES:
Added a Save Game option to the In Game Menu. Now you can save your game wherever you are. The save points are still in the world, but you don't have to go to them anymore to save your game.

Now in the final mission, there is a halfway save point. Once you make it inside the Needle on the Man Island, you will warp back there even when you leave the Man Island and come back.

BUG FIXES:
Fixed a bug where after beating the game the wrong number of chapter stars appeared in Downtown on the mini-map and in the world.

Fixed a bug where you might stay in the final mission after dying.

Fixed a bug where the In Game Menu was not centered on larger resolution screens.

notes.title: Confirm for going to the Main Menu, Balance Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ccee59a9e6d0efe414685c4863faaf1aad4e77b4.jpg[/img]

BALANCE CHANGES:
While in the game, now when you bring the menu up and you press either Main Menu, or Exit Game, you will have to confirm 'Yes,' or 'No.' This will hopefully cause less people accidentally pressing these and loosing their save progress without a confirmation.

A delay has been added in the Jailbreak Competition when you knock out a La Migra agent. So now, when a La Migra agent is knocked out, he will not come back immediately, but in some random span of time.

Ron's Penetration Pound Off got a little easier.

Further decreased the AI's ability to see you when you are invisible in the Spirit Realm.

On high, we doubled the Shadow Resolution for the character shadows. 

BUG FIXES:
The Rubbin' Hood (Hod Chick) achievements will now work.

Fixed minor spelling errors in the text.
